bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm Atorch J7-C

abort.not_supported_device: This Bluetooth device's name does not match a supported Atorch meter. Make sure the device is a genuine Atorch J7-C or UC96 BLE module. If you believe this is wrong, file an issue with diagnostics at {issue_url}.
abort.discovery_only: This integration adds devices through Bluetooth discovery only. Power on your Atorch J7-C, place it in BLE range of your Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth proxy, and wait for Home Assistant's discovery notification. If the device does not appear within a minute, see Troubleshooting in the integration documentation.

init.title: Atorch J7-C options
init.description: Configure how this Atorch J7-C connects.

data_description.connection_mode: Persistent gives one update per second and is best for a single meter. Polled connects every N seconds and is best when you have multiple meters sharing one Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome proxy.
data_description.poll_interval_seconds: Only used in polled mode. How often to connect and read one measurement. Range 10–3600 seconds.

error.interval_out_of_range: Poll interval must be between 10 and 3600 seconds.

unsupported_packet_type.title: Unsupported Atorch device variant
unsupported_packet_type.description:
Your Atorch device is sending packet type 0x{packet_type} ({packet_type_family}), but this integration's v1 only supports the J7-C USB meter (packet type 0x03). What to do:

- If you have a J7-C, this may be a protocol-version mismatch — please file an issue at {issue_url} with the diagnostics download from this integration's device page.
- If you have a different Atorch model (e.g. DL24, UD18, AC meter), support is planned but not yet implemented. **Leave this integration entry in place and dismiss this notification.** Removing the entry will erase any long-term statistics history associated with this device, which may be needed when a future release adds support for your model. Dismissal is persistent — this notification will not reappear for this specific packet type unless you remove and re-add the integration entry.

cannot_connect_after_setup.title: Cannot connect to {device_name}
cannot_connect_after_setup.description:
Home Assistant added your Atorch J7-C ({device_name}) but has not been able to connect to it. Common causes:

- The device is powered off, asleep, or out of Bluetooth range.
- The Bluetooth adapter or transport has dropped offline.
- **If you use an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy:** the proxy may be offline, or may have run out of connection slots. Try the Polled connection mode in this integration's options to free a slot.

The integration will keep retrying. This message clears automatically once the device connects. If you have permanently removed or replaced this meter and no longer want these notifications, delete this integration's device entry from Devices & Services.
